_about: T16: the stage round the fight (crates/core/src/stage.rs). Lengths in cm unless named _m; colours 0-255. Part 1, the floor and its edge: grass tufts on a jittered grid (after CHUMWORLD's scatter.rs, MIT, Sam Gilson), each cell_cm square holding one tuft with tuft_pct chance, tuft_cm_lo..hi tall, coloured blade_mix_pct of the way from the arena's grass to a blade colour and then shaded to blade_shade_pct; tufts shrink over the last sink_m of the floor rather than dither out. One tuft in flower_in has a flower. A gravel path crosses the floor at right angles to the city, path_cm wide, its slabs path_lift_cm above the floor so no two faces share a plane, and as dark as the arena's grass is against path_light (Arena 1's grass). Kerb stones ring the floor's edge; rocks sit among them; props stand outside clear_m so the fight stays open. Hill arenas get railings on the city side and lamp posts; spit arenas a sea wall down to the water and land behind.
_wind: Part 2: the wind (crates/core/src/stage.rs wind, after CHUMWORLD's wind.rs, MIT, Sam Gilson): four travelling waves summed, each toward a heading (degrees, 0 north), so long (m), so fast (cm a second) and so strong (percent). The core steps their phases each tick and sends them as uniforms; the vertex shader bends a tuft's blades by up to tuft_bend_cm at the tip and a tree crown's top by up to crown_bend_cm, the foot never.
_water: Part 3: the water and its froth, after Ape Race's set dressing (ideas only; it has no licence, so nothing is copied). Foam is shapes, not a shader: a collar of broken flat flecks wherever ground meets the water (the spit's sea wall, the hill's foot), with gaps between them so it reads as foam and not a plate; rocks at the waterline, each with a pale skirt a little wider than it; drifting flecks near the shore that live fleck_life ticks each and swell in and out so they never pop; a pier and boats on the lake. foam_pct is the flecks' opacity in percent; lengths in cm unless _m.
_city: Part 4: the outer ring. Buildings step back in tiers (each tier_pct of the one below) and take a roof (flat, wedge, spire or dome); window bands (window_bands on the full stage) are the building's colour by day and lamp light as the sky darkens: dusk runs from 0 when the sky's lightness is dusk_light[0] to 100 at dusk_light[1], and past lit_pct the bands glow. Landmarks: a needle tower, two cranes and a dome near the city's shore. A sea wall runs along the city's waterline with piers off it; a second band of trees stands down the hill; the far hills get terraces; a haze band in the fog's colour stands before them at haze_m, haze_pct opaque.
